title: pcell cheater erosion replicates on seed 3: mean yield 1.0 -> 0.52 with 28 cell deaths (7 cells left) vs neutral twin 1.03, 1 death, 25 cells
summary: Fresh seed 3 with the author's genealogy.py, muy=0.02, sy=0.05, cy=0.5, to t=30000. Real arm (ytrait=1): particle-weighted mean yield in cells 0.84 (t=7850), 0.65 (15250), 0.56 (22650), 0.52 (30000); cells 21 -> 22 -> 17 -> 7; 28 cell deaths, 11 persistent splits. Neutral twin (ytrait=2, same seed): 1.01, 0.98, 1.02, 1.03; 22 -> 25 cells; 1 death, 12 persistent splits. The labkit pack of the real arm (rerun/sheet.png) shows the cells shrinking from t~9000 and dying one by one from t~21000.

observations.F: data/summary.txt: mean yield 0.52 vs twin 1.03 at t=30000, deaths 28 vs 1; rerun/sheet.png t=9000-30000 cells shrink and disappear

controls_run.F: data/twin_s3.log and data/summary.txt (neutral twin ytrait=2, seed 3)

verdicts.limitation: I re-ran only the main point (cy=0.5, muy=0.02); not the rarer-mutation, weaker-cost, dK or parasite arms. The decline is still going at t=30000, so the endpoint (extinction or a floor) is not known.
